title: Lihala's Lute
summary: Alfira’s lute grants Perform. Helping her complete her song can also grant Musical Instrument proficiency.

fields.Perform: Use the free Perform action to play the lute.
fields.Acquisition: Agree to help Alfira with her song. She gives you the lute. You can pocket it or make a DC 10 Performance check to perform with her. Helping her finish grants proficiency.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
